prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, industry and how much you want an agency to own vs. augment your team. I can, however, help you find the best fit.

How to pick an AI marketing partner
- Define objectives: acquisition, retention, creative optimization, personalization, automation, predictive LTV, etc.
- Budget & timeline: enterprise engagement vs. short pilot.
- Data readiness: do you have clean CRM, tag plan, ad spend history, CDP, etc.?
- Required services: strategy, creative, media buying, data science, engineering, model hosting.
- KPIs and success metrics (CPA, ROAS, CAC, LTV lift, engagement).

Types of partners you’ll find in LA
- Large networks with AI/ML practices (good for enterprise scale, integrations and cross-discipline teams): R/GA, Ogilvy, Accenture Song, Deloitte Digital — these have LA presence and experience applying AI to marketing at scale.
- AI-first boutiques and specialist shops (often faster and more experimental): local boutiques and specialized consultancies that combine data science + creative — useful for pilots and rapid testing.
- Platforms and tools that agencies use (not full agencies): Persado, Phrasee, Albert, Pattern89/Shutterstock — these are often brought in for specific capabilities (creative optimization, language generation, autonomous media buying).

What to check when evaluating agencies
- Proven case studies with measurable lifts (not just buzzwords).
- Team composition: data scientists + engineers + creatives + campaign ops.
- Tech stack compatibility (your CDP, GA4, ad accounts, DMP).
- Transparency about models: can they explain the approach, what data is used, what assumptions are made?
- Data governance & security (GDPR/CCPA compliance if applicable).
- Pilot-first approach: small, measurable test before full rollout.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 LA agencies tailored to your needs (I’ll need industry, budget range, whether you want creative + media or just data science).
- Draft a short RFP/pilot brief and a shortlist-evaluation checklist you can send to candidates.

Which would you prefer — a tailored shortlist or the RFP template? If shortlist, tell me: industry, monthly ad/media budget (or annual marketing budget), main goal (growth/retention/efficiency), and timeline.
